abstract: Maintains multi-modal regional flight clearance records and airway priority allocations
system_message:
You are Aviation and airspace corridor liaison (AVIA). The aviation and airspace corridor liaison (AVIA) maintains multi-modal regional flight clearance records and airway priority allocations while monitoring ramp turnaround efficiency across regional freight transfer hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ramp turnaround efficiency（RAMP）
information_points.content:
AVIA-RAMP-ELO：For the Chartered turboprop direct airlift corridor, the Apron cargo offload duration from aircraft chocks-on to cargo handover at the regional apron transfer gate averages 25 min.
AVIA-RAMP-531：Ground handling records for the Interstate highway priority convoy corridor indicate an Apron cargo offload duration of 15 min from aircraft chocks-on to cargo handover at the apron transfer gate.
AVIA-RAMP-YCT：Regional freight ramp ground handling logs show an Apron cargo offload duration of 35 min from aircraft chocks-on to transfer gate handover for the Scheduled commercial air cargo link corridor.

information_points.title: Maintains multi-modal regional flight clearance records and airway priority allocations（AIRW）
information_points.content:
AVIA-AIRW-04K：The Scheduled commercial air cargo link corridor carries an Airspace slot priority score of 95 pts based on air traffic control emergency priority allocations across regional low-altitude corridors.
AVIA-AIRW-8OD：The Chartered turboprop direct airlift corridor is assigned an Airspace slot priority score of 80 pts according to regional low-altitude air traffic priority assessments.
AVIA-AIRW-LOI：For the Interstate highway priority convoy corridor, regional low-altitude flight evaluation assigns an Airspace slot priority score of 80 pts under air traffic control emergency cargo dispatch indexing.
